Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Define the compound set from parent CHEMBL2403108 using molecule_hierarchy to include the parent and all salts. Join to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter for target CHEMBL4247 and activities with standard_type IC50 and standard_units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Do not limit results.
